representation_fit.evidence: Brief's shape is many/high-temporality/high-density metrics to monitor; the implementation is a single-screen wall of 24 metric tiles in 4 groups, each tile carrying value+unit+delta+sparkline with threshold lines (data.js:44-94, app.js:167-181), plus a persistent right rail with a 90-point trace, warn/crit threshold lines, and a timestamped anomaly feed (index.html:42-81; both screenshots 1280x860 and 1440x900). Primary object 'metric' is the atom of the UI exactly as suggested.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Anomaly-spotting dominates the initial screen: header severity chips with live counts (危急 2 / 告警 4, screenshot 1280x860 top bar; app.js:205-211), crit tiles with red left border/tint/badge (订单队列深度 961, 卡拒付率 6.83%) and warn tiles in yellow (styles.css:167-169,180-182), and the app auto-selects the most recent crit anomaly at load so the traceability panel opens on the hottest object (app.js:442-444; right rail in both screenshots shows 卡拒付率 危急 with '异常自 05:21:07 起，已持续 0:11').

time_to_understand.evidence: Within one glance the screen states what (脉墙 PulseWall · 易变指标监控, index.html:17-18), where (4 named domain headers 接入网关/订单域/支付域/库存域 with per-group status counts, app.js:213-223), and what is wrong (color-coded borders/badges + header counts). Model-judged proxy: no loading state, first data ready synchronously at init (app.js:424-447 '首屏即 ready'; data.js:113-137), visible populated tiles in both screenshots.

navigation_cost.evidence: All 24 metrics visible on the single main screen simultaneously; reaching any detail is 1 click (tile → select, app.js:66; feed row click-to-jump → select, app.js:111-114); filtering is one click on severity/group chips (app.js:343-355, 85-104); Space pauses the stream (app.js:414-422). No modes, routes, or drill-down pages exist in source.

context_loss.evidence: Filtering dims tiles instead of hiding them — '置灰保位，不做隐藏重排 → 位置语义恒定' (app.js:329-341; styles.css:164,128) so spatial position and orientation are preserved; selection is a persistent side-panel highlight with Esc to dismiss (app.js:323-327, 419-421), never a navigation away from the wall. Feed jumps select in place, keeping the wall visible (index.html:42-81 layout).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are exactly: header (brand, heartbeat/clock, 3 severity chips + 5 group chips, pause), wall, inspector, feed (index.html:13-80; screenshots). Every control maps to the monitoring job (triage counts, stream freeze for reading); no decorative chrome, no modals; grid auto-fill keeps density high but uniform (styles.css:141-145). Signal-over-chrome stated design rule (styles.css:1-2).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails all three measured a11y checks plus type size: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json checks). Consistent with source: low-contrast tokens --faint #5c6880 and --muted #8e9ab3 carry much label text (styles.css:12-13, 172, 186-187), tiny type at 9.5-11px for chips/timestamps (styles.css:268, 267, 213), compact 3px-padding filter buttons (styles.css:81-89). Mitigations exist but don't offset the fails: :focus-visible outlines (styles.css:111-114), aria-pressed toggles (app.js:93,98,407), live aria-labels on tiles (app.js:199), prefers-reduced-motion respect (styles.css:283-286), keyboard Space/Esc/Tab-Enter flow (index.html:50; app.js:414-422).

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow=pass, layout.responsive_collision=pass, text.truncation=pass, target_invalid=false (measurement-summary.json); both screenshots show clean grids at 1280 and 1440 with graceful 3→4 column reflow. However 4 of 7 receipt checks failed (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size), implying compliance remediation rework across palette, type scale, and focus management before delivery quality bar is met.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '指标变化可追溯，无闪烁噪声' is covered on both halves. Traceability: anomalySince() derives anomaly start by walking the status run (app.js:251-256), inspector renders 90-point trace with warn/crit threshold lines and a highlighted 'hot' anomaly segment (app.js:284-304, visible in right rail of both screenshots), 12 timestamped per-sample deltas with per-point status (app.js:306-320, screenshot list 最近采样变化), and initial events are replayed from history so feed and trace agree point-for-point (app.js:359-373). No-flicker: DOM nodes built once, ticks only replace textContent/attributes/path d, no entry animations, tabular-nums (app.js:2-9; styles.css:76,185,233), plus a pause control to freeze the stream for reading (index.html:36-39).

defects_observed: Header '全部' chip shows 18, which is the ok-count (METRICS.length - crit - warn, app.js:210), not the metric total of 24 visible in group counts (接入网关 6 + 订单域 6 + 支付域 6 + 库存域 6, screenshots) — count semantics are misleading at a glance
a11y.contrast / a11y.focus_order / a11y.target_size / type.min_projected_size all fail per receipt (measurement-summary.json checks)
Very small metadata type (9.5px feed chips, 10px status column, 10.5-11px hints/timestamps; styles.css:268,246,267,213) consistent with the min-projected-size failure
Low-contrast faint/muted palette (#5c6880, #8e9ab3) used for primary label text on dark tiles (styles.css:12-13,172,186) consistent with the contrast failure

At 1280x860 the 库存域 bottom row is clipped below the fold (screenshot 1280x860); acceptable since #wall scrolls (styles.css:125), but 6th-group content is not all visible in one glance at this viewport
missing_evidence: Root cause of the a11y.focus_order failure is not determinable from the sanitized summary plus source (focus-visible styling and keyboard handlers exist, but the specific order/sequential-focus defect is unobserved)
scores.overall_note: impl-06 is a tightly scoped single-screen metric wall that matches the cell's shape bundle (many, high-temporality, high-density, monitor verb) almost point for point: all 24 metrics are permanently on screen, anomalies are the most salient visual signal (red/yellow borders, live severity counts, auto-selected hottest critical anomaly with anomaly-start time and duration), and the acceptance seed is explicitly engineered on both halves — per-point timestamped deltas, threshold lines and a highlighted anomaly segment give full change traceability, while one-time DOM construction with in-place updates, tabular numerals and a stream pause deliver flicker-free reading (app.js:2-9, 251-320, 359-373). Navigation and context costs are minimal (1-click select, dim-not-hide filtering, persistent inspector). The clear weak spot is accessibility: all three measured a11y checks plus minimum projected type size fail in the receipt, matching widespread 9.5-11px label text and low-contrast faint/muted tokens in the stylesheet, so the otherwise clean layout (3/3 layout checks pass, no responsive collisions or truncation) would need a palette/type/focus remediation pass. One minor labeling defect: the '全部' header chip counts only normal metrics (18) rather than the 24-metric total.
